title: Checkout attempt collision during replay
summary: Order submission retries are rejected during persistence, and affected carts remain in a pending state.
precursor: A delayed client retry overlapped with an asynchronous reconciliation of the same checkout session.
impact: Customers cannot complete checkout for affected sessions; support staff must reconcile the pending attempts before retrying.

title: Stock allocation misses checkout deadline
summary: Cart submissions stop at stock allocation and return dependency deadline errors despite the reservation API remaining available.
precursor: A promotion increased multi-warehouse reservation fanout shortly after a new checkout path was enabled.
impact: A portion of customers cannot place orders before their carts expire, while retries add more load to the reservation path.

title: Order confirmation events stop advancing
summary: Order confirmation processing repeatedly stalls at the same delivery, leaving later events unprocessed.
precursor: A producer rollout began emitting an optional fulfillment field while a consumer deployment was being rolled back.
impact: Customers see delayed order confirmations and downstream fulfillment creation falls behind for the affected partition.

title: Payment authorization unavailable after renewal
summary: New checkout attempts fail at payment authorization with a sudden rise in credential-related responses.
precursor: The overnight payment credential renewal completed while checkout replicas were still rolling between releases.
impact: Customers cannot submit paid orders, although carts and inventory reservations continue to be created.

title: Address verification endpoint lookup failures
summary: Order creation fails during address verification even though the intake service and other dependencies are healthy.
precursor: A namespace migration moved the verifier workload during a release that also changed its service registration.
impact: New orders for regions requiring address verification are rejected, while existing orders continue through fulfillment.
